claim_boundary: all dates are historical and not independent OOS
five classic candidates are frozen as one family before their outcomes are inspected
Holm correction and winner selection use 2022-2023 only
only one development winner may enter 2024plus locked temporal validation
a pass creates a prospective forward-test candidate only

signal.missing_raw: ineligible for this factor's new or retained membership

portfolio.outcome: fifth common market-session open return from entry

benchmark.definition: same-week equal-weight gross return of all finite entry-tradable eligible stocks

statistics.estimand: candidate net weekly return minus theoretical all-eligible gross benchmark
statistics.development_multiplicity: Holm-adjusted one-sided HAC p over all five candidates

decision_rules.development_pass: active mean>=0.25%; Holm p<0.05; bootstrap q05>0; both halves active mean>0; candidate net mean>0; observable rate>=98%; max drawdown<=35%
decision_rules.selection: largest development bootstrap q05, then active mean, then lexical id among passing candidates
decision_rules.validation_opening: no validation outcomes or artifacts unless at least one development candidate passes
decision_rules.validation_pass: locked winner meets the same numerical rules with unadjusted one-sided HAC p<0.05 and both validation halves positive
decision_rules.cost_stress_pass: at 60bp development and validation active means and bootstrap q05 remain positive
decision_rules.candidate_status: RETROSPECTIVE_CLASSIC_FACTOR_CANDIDATE_FORWARD_TEST_REQUIRED only if development, validation, and cost stress pass
decision_rules.failure_status: FAMILY_FALSIFIED_RETROSPECTIVE; no sign, transformation, neutralization, target-size, buffer, or holding-period rescue
